scope: Independent read-only source review. No tests, compilation, process observations, engine calls or shared changes.
sourceConclusions: The string compatibility helper delegates to exactly one fact-producing helper. Each observation executes the same one unix.Poll(poll,0) as before.
Nil, negative or overflowing descriptor and malformed attempt return before Poll; absent or consumed inputs expose no count or revents.
Live remains exact n==0 and Revents==0. Exited remains exact n==1 and Revents==POLLIN. HUP and combined bits remain unknown.
The helper only borrows the retained descriptor; no Close, duplicate, PID lookup, signals or ownership adoption were added.

Facts contain fixed result/performed fields, count, uint16 revents and a closed errno category. Type assertion to syscall.Errno never invokes unknown Error/Is/As/Unwrap methods. No PID, FD or raw errors are retained.
Failure evidence emits the validated cold attempt only when Poll was performed; invalid preflight values remain blank. This is diagnostic correlation, not ownership/readiness authority.

Control changes assert actual live and unreaped exit facts plus absent/malformed/consumed refusal and serialization. Original three-second lifecycle before Start, immediate sole-Wait cleanup, checked Close results and fd=-1 consumption are unchanged.
limits: This review does not reconstruct the historical unknown Poll outcome.
No actual execution or errno-negative control is admitted by this source review.
The original child control remains subject to supported OS scheduling and physical reap limits.
recommendedNextAction: Root may authorize the single anchored owned-child control on these exact bytes; actual Docker acceptance remains separate.
